evidence.explanation: Through this optional reader with default -2, the val == -1 RNG branch cannot be reached by a successful public feature argument read.
evidence.proof: get_table_boolean_opt returns -2 for absent fields or calls get_table_boolean. Successful boolean/integer reads return 0/1, recognized strings return option index 0..3; all other reads raise a nonreturning Lua error. None returns -1. Exact C reader and flag-helper bodies plus 27 public JS initializations (fountain/throne/tree × nine valid representations) confirm mask writes and zero draws. This is a reader-local reachability proof, not universal boolean or runtime feature equivalence.
evidence.control: Boolean true/false controls demonstrate the feature flag write path executes. Absent, numeric 0/1 and four recognized strings are targets. No forced internal -1 injection is used.
